    Employment Opportunities

    Want to Run
    Iron With Us?

    Menke Excavating, LLC is a growing utility and dirt work company and a family owned business serving commercial and residential customers. We specialize in storm drain improvement, water line repair and replacement, and excavation.

    HIRING

    Laborer

    • Experience with water lines, storm water and concrete work preferred
    • Not required to apply. We will train the right candidate
    HIRING

    Operator

    • Minimum 2 years' experience operating
    • Willing and able to labor as projects require
    HIRING

    Foreman

    • Minimum 5 years' experience leading a crew
    • Minimum 2 years' experience operating
    • Experience reading plans and setting grade
    What We Need
    • Self-motivated, hard-working individuals
    • Able to pass a drug screening
    • Clean driver's license
    • Flexible in job roles and committed to project completion
    What We Offer
    • Weekly pay with direct deposit
    • Competitive wages, with wage reviews after 6 months
    • Overtime possibilities
    • Monday to Friday, weather permitting. Saturdays occasionally required
